canon.silhouette: thin and destitute - a rag-wrapped soft-topped head with no hard headgear and no brim line, narrow sloping shoulders, and one rigid haft on a hard forty-five degree diagonal, thick and dead straight along its whole length, gripped at the chest and stopping well below the top of the head
canon.reads_as: a person who picked up a tool and followed the light - destitute, not equipped

prompt.description: A destitute volunteer with nothing that was ever issued to them. An oversized head wrapped in a torn cloth rag, no helmet and no brim, an open face with two sunken eyes. A plain unbelted shirt, thin sloping shoulders, bare wrapped legs and rag-bound feet. Shouldered out to one side at a hard forty-five degree angle, one thick stiff wooden haft with a small squared iron cap. Nothing on this person is armour.
must_include: torn cloth rag wrapping the head, knotted to one side - no helmet or brim
one thick wooden haft on a hard forty-five degree diagonal, dead straight and rigid, the same thickness along its whole length
the haft gripped at the chest and stopping below the top of the head - it never rises past the crown
a small squared iron cap on the raised end, no wider than the haft
a plain unbelted shirt and bare wrapped legs, no armour of any kind
two dark sunken eye recesses in an open face
must_avoid: helmet, skullcap, brim, visor, crest or plume
any armour plate, pauldron, mail or greaves
spear, polearm or any weapon held vertically
a curved, bent, drooping, tapering or flexible haft, or a rope, chain, whip or flail
an axe head, blade, hammer or ball on the end of the haft
any held object rising above the top of the head
lamp, torch, candle or visible flame
glow, halo, sparks or rays around any pixel
large solid black masses, heavy internal outlining or cast shadow
